The difference was caused by an error made by Daimler India Commercial Vehicles Pvt. Ltd. Wherein the OEM incorrectly reported invoices for February and March 2019 under the taxpayer's old GSTIN and later corrected the mistake in May 2019 by amending the GSTR-1 returns. As a result, a mismatch arose between GSTR-2A and GSTR-3B. Drop Order Received on 28/03/2024. Form GST APL-03 Received on 27/09/2024. Order received on 11/06/2025. Review is allowed. timeline.summary: CRISIL Ratings reaffirmed subsidiary Popular Mega Motors' bank loan facilities of ₹235.55 Cr at CRISIL A/Stable / A1.
On 22 May 2026, Popular Vehicles and Services announced the resignation of CEO Raj Narayan, effective 21 August 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,754.45 Cr, net loss ₹4.96 Cr (against a loss of ₹13.72 Cr a year earlier).
Popular Vehicles reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,758.8 Cr, up 27.8% YoY, with EBITDA rising 93.5% to ₹57.5 Cr.
Popular Vehicles and Services Ltd made the audio recording of its Q4 FY2026 Investor & Analyst Conference Call available on its website on 2026-05-27.
On 27 May 2026 Popular Vehicles' Q4/FY26 call guided FY27 to high double-digit revenue growth, a 4.8-5% EBITDA margin and PAT near FY24 levels, with sustainable profitability from Q2FY27.
Popular Vehicles board approved amending its Articles of Association to simplify the process for affixing the common seal on corporate documents.
